hero.intro: A fourth-year student at Epitech Nantes, currently on exchange at <ruc>Roskilde University</ruc> in Denmark, I build robust web, DevOps and software solutions.

about.heading: About
about.p1: Hi! I'm a fourth-year student at <epitech>Epitech Nantes</epitech> (Class of 2028), enrolled in the Expert en Informatique programme — a Master's-level Expert in Computer Science, French RNCP Level 7. Passionate about web, DevOps and software development, I build robust, modern solutions.
about.p2: I am spending the 2026-2027 academic year on exchange at <ruc>Roskilde University</ruc> in Denmark, in the Master's programme in Computer Science.
about.p3: I have had the opportunity to grow my skills across several experiences, notably at <revolte>Revolte E-garages</revolte>, where I helped build a full-stack platform for garage owners. I am also involved in volunteer initiatives such as <reso2d>RESO2D</reso2d> (Green IT) and DevFest Nantes.
